name: ch582-experimental-peripheral
rules: Explicit experimental selection; never the CH585 default.
One Peripheral link; Central and dual-role excluded from this memory profile.
Full BLE+USB simultaneous enablement requires independent SRAM and physical acceptance.
Trim resources in the CH582 module only; do not weaken HCI/LL ownership or MIC semantics.
Revalidate all chip register, DMA, timer and RF differences.
